+from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
+from rich.text import Text
+
+def test_url_with_at():
+    highlighter = ReprHighlighter()
+    url = "https://user:pass@example.com"
+    text = Text(url)
+    highlighter.highlight(text)
+    
+    assert len(text.spans) > 0, f"URL should be highlighted, but spans are: {text.spans}"
+    for span in text.spans:
+        assert span.style == "repr.url", f"Expected style 'repr.url', got {span.style!r}"
+        assert span.start == 0, f"Expected start 0, got {span.start}"
+        assert span.end == len(url), f"Expected end {len(url)}, got {span.end}"
+        break
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    try:
+        test_url_with_at()
+        print("Test passed!")
+    except AssertionError as e:
+        print(f"Test failed: {e}")
+        exit(1)
+    except Exception as e:
+        print(f"An unexpected error occurred: {e}")
+        exit(1)
